label: preparing
what: A secret surprise jubilee feast for the mayor in the great hall on day 1 at 18:00, with lantern decorations and a target of 200 fresh loaves. Builder, freight and innkeeper coordinated lighting, supplies, baking and deliveries; baker knowingly helped with oven access and wheat. The mayor approved attendance under a lighting-inspection description, not the feast. Secretary facilitated that appointment but the record does not establish knowing participation in the surprise; their later logged inquiry says its purpose was not established. Neither neighbour nor watchman is established as a knowing helper. Logged journal entries explicitly describe secrecy and are corroborated by transfers, baking, lantern placement and hall deliveries.
